test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The furniture displayed a wonderful combination of __elegance__ and practicality.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gracelessness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"elegance"** means the quality of being graceful and stylish in appearance or manner. (शालीनता, सुंदरता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her dress exuded **elegance **and class at the gala event.
 
 
 
• **"Gracelessness" **refers to the lack of elegance, grace, or style; being clumsy or awkward. (भद्दापन)
 
 
• **Example: **His **gracelessness **was evident when he stumbled during the dance performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'elegance'** is **'gracelessness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Simplicity **(सादगी): The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

 
 
• **Example:** The **simplicity **of her design made it a favourite among the judges.
 
 
 
• **Magnificence **(भव्यता): The quality of being **magnificent**; grandeur or splendour.
 
 
• **Example: **The magnificence of the palace left the visitors in awe.
 
 
 
• **Glory** (महिमा): High renown or honour won by notable achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** The team basked in the **glory **of their championship win.
